• Education: BSc or MSc in Analytical Chemistry or Industrial Chemistry.

MAIN PURPOSE OF POSITION:
Manage the allocated debtors’ book by collecting payments on or before they are due and minimizing bad debts by following internal policies and procedures. Establish and maintain excellent relationships with all internal and external parties through constant communication. Work in line with credit legislation. Resolving account-related queries with a matter of urgency and maintaining an elevated level of customer service on all matters related to Accounts Receivable.
Credit Controller Duties and Responsibilities
Banking and Payment Allocations:
• Checking the various bank statements daily to identify payments made for the debtors assigned to the credit controller.
• Capturing the payment receipt on the ERP system.
• Allocating the payment according to the official remittance from the partner or an email from the partner advising which invoices to clear with the specific payment. Payments may NEVER be allocated from the oldest invoices forward UNLESS the credit controller has written confirmation from the Finance manager at the partner’s company.
• Save the payment batch in the specified folder for auditing purposes in line with the payment allocation process.
• If the credit controller has no remittance or instruction email on how to allocate the payment at the time the payment shows on the bank statement, the credit controller must phone and email the partner for the remittance or payment instructions. The credit controller will follow up on the remittance or payment instruction email daily for 2 days, and then the AR Supervisor must request the remittance or payment instruction email from the partner.
• If a remittance or payment instruction email is still not received on day 3 after the payment was received on the account, the credit controller will send a debtor’s aging ledger to the partner, marking which invoices will be cleared with the specific payment, and will then email it to the partner advising that allocation will take place accordingly. Payments allocated in this manner will not be reversed later when a remittance or payment instruction is received.Customer Statements:
• As soon as the Group Credit & AR Manager confirms all statements have been sent after month-end closure, the Credit controller will check System1A daily to ensure that the partners have viewed their statements.
• If the partner has not viewed their statement after the 3rd day, the credit controller will phone and email the partner to confirm the statement link was received and check if it was sent to junk mail or blocked.
• If the partner confirms that the statement has still not been received, the credit controller will resend a statement and ask the partner to confirm receiptInvoices, PODs, Credit notes, and Other Supporting Documents:
• The credit controller must send out Invoices, PODs, Credit notes, and all other supporting documents as and when required by the partner.
• The credit controller must then also educate the partner to use System1A so that they may access any required documents from that system in the future.
Recons:
• The credit controller must have an updated recons with full reasons for non-payment on EVERY account that has queries. This bank reconciliation must be ready and available to be sent to sales, the AR Supervisor, and or the Group Credit and AR Manager as needed.
• Collection process:
• The credit controller must phone each account on their assigned debtors book a minimum of 3 times:
• After the month-end statements are sent to ensure the statement was received and viewed.
• In the middle of the month to ask if there are any queries or issues to address before the month-end payment is due.
• The last week of the month to confirm the amount and date of payment for the payment that is due at the month's end, and to ensure that the payment is made so that it is in our bank on or before the last day of the month.
• It must be made clear to partners that we cannot allow late payments after payments are made.
• The credit controller must pull their age every Monday and work on it for the week by prioritizing the highest and oldest overdue accounts.
• These partners must be contacted once a week until their account is paid for in full
• The credit controller must also contact partners that have unapplied payments (and again remind the partner that this can be viewed on System1A) and or credit notes on their account, and ask the partner to either take back the payment or credits with their next payment or to advise the credit controller how to allocate
• Any unallocated cash (older than 6 months) and unallocated credits (older than 3 months) will be moved off the account.
• The credit controller must ask for the assistance of the sales team when collection efforts have been unsuccessful and ask them to arrange meetings with the partners to discuss the overdue payments, but the credit controller may never expect the salesperson to collect outstanding payments on their behalf.Monthly SPLA Order Process
• After the 8th working day of the new month, a report will be sent to the credit controller (Applicable to credit controllers dealing with Cloud partners) by the Cloud Partner Support team. The Credit controller then must urgently ensure that the following is done before the 15th working day of the new month for the business to release the partner’s SPLA orders:
• Overdue accounts – phone the partner and ask for immediate payment, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account is not paid up to date.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• Over-trading accounts - phone the partner and ask for immediate payment to bring their account into credit again, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account does not have sufficient credit limit.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• Insufficient credit limit accounts - phone the partner and ask for immediate payment to bring their account into credit limit again, advising we won’t be able to release their SPLA orders if their account does not have sufficient credit limit.
• The credit controller must also remind the partner of the 8% late reporting penalty from Microsoft or possible termination if we cannot release SPLA orders.
• The credit limit must also ask the Vetting team to apply for more cover with CGIC or motivate the Credit Committee to approve an internal lim-it to release the SPLA orders.Reporting On Overdue Accounts:
• The credit controller will receive a weekly Overdue feedback report from the Group Credit and AR Manager, whereby detailed feedback needs to be provided on the TOP 50 Overdue accounts for all the group companies.
• This feedback will be consolidated by the AR Supervisor and sent to the Group Credit and AR Manager no later than COB on Wednesday.Queries:
• The credit controller must log on to all Cloud-related queries as soon as they are identified on the JIRA query system.
• If the query is not resolved within 4 days, the credit controller must escalate to the AR Supervisor to address and must bring to the attention of the Group Credit and AR manager if any large accounts require specialized attention or are in a state of disarray.
• For all other queries, the credit controller must email the relevant product / brand team and copy the sales-person to assist with the resolution of the query. The credit controller must follow the standard escalation process until the query is resolved.
• The credit controller must communicate and provide feedback to the partner regarding the query on a weekly basis until the query is resolved.Adjustments:
• The Credit controller should capture adjustments like interest reversals, discounts approved, small balance write-offs (under R10),

Purpose of the Role:
The FAIS Supervisor plays a key role in supporting the Key Individual (“KI”) by ensuring that all
external agents, quality assurance agents or call centre agents adhere to the requirements as
provided for in the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act (“FAIS”). The role reports
directly to the Head of Legal and Compliance, though the FAIS Supervisor will be trained and
managed by the KI, gaining valuable experience and mentorship with a view to ultimately
transition into a future KI role. The Supervisor will act as the primary line of defense in
conjunction with the Quality Assurance Team in identifying and addressing any compliance
issues within sales practices, reviewing the effectiveness of the Quality Assurance processes,
ensuring that the KI's strategic oversight is well-supported with accurate and consistent
monitoring.
This role ensures that sales practices across all distribution channels meet legal standards,
thereby protecting the company from legal risks and ensuring that all agents operate ethically
and within regulatory boundaries.
The FAIS Supervisor is essential in maintaining the integrity of the supervisory process and
ensuring that all agents meet the required competencies to be fully independent.
Role Summary:
As the FAIS Supervisor, you will take on the direct supervision of agents, regularly evaluating
their sales activities to ensure they meet the FAIS requirements and other regulatory
standards.
Your primary focus will be to ensure that agents comply with legal requirements, avoid
misrepresentation, and protect customers from mis-selling. You will conduct monthly
competency assessments, review sales practices, and ensure ongoing compliance, providing
the KI with detailed reports and feedback on agent performance. This data will be crucial for
the KI to assess agent competency, identify training needs, and make informed decision.
You will play a key role in maintaining the integrity of the compliance process, ensuring clear
communication with both agents and the KI about performance and compliance issues. By
thoroughly assessing sales processes, offering coaching, and identifying areas for
improvement, you will help the KI mitigate regulatory risks and create an environment where
agents can succeed, achieve their goals, and positively impact the lives of our customers.
Benefits:
• The right candidate will have a clear path for growth into a KI role, with the opportunity to
work closely alongside the KI and Head of Legal and Compliance. This collaboration will
provide valuable hands-on experience in compliance leadership and regulatory oversight.
• Ongoing mentorship and training in regulatory compliance, enhancing skills for future
leadership roles.Key Responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance Oversight:
• Ensure that all call centre agents adhere to the requirements in FAIS and other regulatory
requirements by monitoring their daily activities, reviewing sales interactions, and
confirming that legal standards are met.Competency Assessments:
• Development of Supervision Plans for each agent requiring supervision.
• Conduct monthly competency evaluations of agents, assessing their ability to comply with
FAIS requirements, demonstrating ethical sales practices, and identifying areas for
improvement.Sales Activity Monitoring:
• Review and evaluate a sample of sales calls and transactions, ensuring compliance with
FAIS and preventing misrepresentation or mis-selling. Ensure that agents meet all legal
and ethical sales requirements.Reporting and Feedback:
• Prepare detailed compliance reports for the KI, summarizing the results of your
assessments and feedback on agent performance. Provide actionable recommendations
for ongoing training and improvements.Communication with Agents:
• Deliver clear and constructive feedback to agents, outlining areas for improvement and
reinforcing compliance standards. Set specific expectations for performance, ensuring
alignment with regulatory requirements.Agent Development and Training:
• Work closely with agents to identify competency gaps and provide coaching to improve
performance. Assist in the development of agents so they can eventually transition from
supervision to independent operation.Documentation and Record Keeping:
• Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all assessments, evaluations, and feedback
sessions, ensuring proper documentation for compliance reviews and audits with
company compliance strategies and address any compliance concerns or issues.
Risk Mitigation:
• Identify potential compliance risks and proactively recommend corrective actions to
minimise legal exposure. Support the KI in addressing compliance issues and maintaining
the company’s reputation for legal and ethical conduct.Technical Skills:
• Strong understanding of FAIS, compliance requirements, and other applicable financial
services regulations.
• High level of proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and Word, to analyse data,
generate reports, and document compliance activities.
• Skilled in reviewing sales processes to spot any compliance issues and suggest practical
improvements.
Soft Skills:
• Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively provide feedback to Agents,
Team Leaders, Supervisors, and preparation of detailed compliance reports for the KI.
• A meticulous approach to reviewing sales activities, identifying compliance risks, and
ensuring accuracy in reporting.
• Commitment to upholding high standards of integrity and ethical conduct, especially
when dealing with sensitive compliance matters.
• Demonstrated capacity for leading, mentoring, and coaching agents while ensuring
compliance with regulatory standards.
• Ability to quickly adapt to evolving regulations, processes, and company requirements.Experience:
• 3+ years of experience in the long-term insurance industry, with a focus on compliance,
supervision, or regulatory oversight.
• Call centre experience preferred but not required.
• Proven track record in assessing and monitoring sales performance, especially in relation
to compliance standards and regulatory requirements.
• Experience providing coaching, feedback and performance improvement plans to help
agents align with compliance standards.
• Ability to speak and understand multiple languages
Qualifications:
• Minimum NQF Level 5 Qualification (FSCA recognised)
• RE 1 / RE 5: Regulatory exams (Beneficial)
• FAIS-Specific Training, Additional FAIS or compliance certifications are highly
advantageous to demonstrate a strong grasp of relevant financial regulations.

National Senior Certificate (NQF Level 4)
Minimum Experience: N/A
Primary Responsibilities & Duties
Main purpose of the Job:
To handle the movement of both inbound and outbound cargo in line with the standard operating processes (SOPs) and the operational guidelines of our partner airlines.
Environmental / Other conditions:
• Shift Work – extended hours
• Must be able to work in a warehouse environment
• Three months on-the-job required
Behavioural: Customer Service | Handling of Cargo| Scanning of Cargo | Check equipment for serviceability | Safe and secure workplace
Skills: Deadline driven | Able to work under deadlines | Communication skills
Customer service | Technical competency | Light machinery
Duties:
Customer Service
• Ensure that all clients are informed of the cargo process in a clear and concise manner.
• Comply with the client's specifications so that their cargo is placed on the correct route.
• When on duty, maintain a friendly and positive attitude towards all the clients and colleagues.
Handling of Cargo
• Meet and greet the customer from the ramp and assist with offloading their cargo.
• Verify weight, dimensions and commodity against the Airwaybill presented by the account holder/customer.
• Assist the walk-in / cash customer to complete the cash form to ensure that it is completed correctly with customer information, weight, dimensions, commodity and routing.
• Direct the customer to the acceptance area once all has been verified.
• Ensure that the customer affixes the tracking labels onto the shipment correctly, then liaise with security personnel for screening of cargo.
• Remove cargo off the x-ray belt once screening is completed to prepare for segregation.
• Communicate with the Cargo Handler- Manifesting in order to prepare for flight planning.
• Perform relevant scanning disciplines and load the trucks as directed by the Cargo Handler- Manifesting
Scanning of Cargo
• Adhere to all scanning disciplines in the assigned sphere of the operations by verifying and reconciling it against the previous scan phase to ensure correct information is transmitted to the customers and our airline manifesting staff.
• Utilise the systems generated scan discrepancy reports to reconcile the assigned scanning phase so that any irregularities can be recorded and assigned to staff for further investigation.
• Engage with the Cargo Handler Manifesting and/or Duty Manager for any discrepancies in order for all the information to be recorded and documented to ensure that closure is in line with customer and company expectations.
Check equipment for serviceability
• Report unserviceable devices to ensure connectivity to the internet and log-in credential to prevent any delays during operational times.
• Check all the assigned unit load devices before the start of the operation for serviceability, by inspecting the cargo and panels for any damages, to ensure ease of loading at the aircraft in order to prevent any delays and/or safety incidents.
• Complete all assigned checklist with regards to warehouse equipment to evaluate operational readiness in order to manage any possible bottlenecks with the processing of cargo inside the warehouse.
Safe and secure Workplace
• Maintain a safe and secure working environment displaying your permit card and wearing Personal Protective Equipment/clothing at all times in order to conform to Occupational Health and Safety and Company protocols.
• Perform all duties with high degree of vigilance and attentiveness (safety and security) when processing cargo to avoid any potential risk that may hinder the operations.
• Report any defects to the Duty Manager in order for corrective action to be initiated that will reduce and/or eliminate any potential safety hazards.

Our client, a global company operating in the fruit industry and situated in Paarl (Western Cape), has an exciting career opportunity for a Cost Accountant to join their team.
This is a hybrid role that requires 2–3 office days per week.
The ideal candidate is analytical and detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving, organisational and communication skills, and the ability to build effective working relationships while driving continuous improvement.
The successful candidate will take responsibility for managing and optimising the organisation's product, inventory and production costs.
KPI’s will include (but not be limited to):
• Cost Management & Cost Analysis: Reviewing operational and production costs; developing and maintaining costing models; analysing profitability, margins and cost variances; identifying cost reduction opportunities and recommending operational improvements.
• Inventory Accounting & Valuation: Maintaining inventory costing methodologies; reviewing inventory valuations; coordinating stock counts; investigating inventory variances; monitoring inventory provisions; ensuring accurate cost of goods sold reporting.
• Budgeting & Forecasting: Supporting annual budgets and forecasts; preparing departmental cost budgets; monitoring budget performance; assisting with scenario planning and strategic cost projections.
• Management Reporting: Preparing monthly cost and profitability reports; producing operational performance reports; presenting cost analyses and financial insights; monitoring financial and operational KPIs.
• Capital Expenditure & Investment Analysis: Evaluating capital expenditure proposals; conducting cost-benefit and return-on-investment analyses; monitoring approved capital projects; supporting investment decisions.
• Continuous Improvement & Process Optimisation: Identifying process improvement opportunities; enhancing costing procedures and controls; supporting system improvements; improving reporting capabilities and costing methodologies.
• Internal Controls & Governance: Maintaining inventory and costing controls; reviewing costing processes; ensuring compliance with company policies and accounting standards; supporting internal and external audits.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Partnering with operational and commercial teams; supporting management with financial analysis; communicating cost information; building cross-functional relationships.
Essential qualifications, skills, and experience:
• BCom degree in Accounting, Management Accounting, Cost Accounting or an equivalent qualification required; registration with CIMA, SAIPA, SAICA or a related professional body will be advantageous;
• Experience in Cost or Management Accounting, including costing models, inventory accounting, budgeting and forecasting, operational and production cost analysis, and management reporting;
• Experience in the agricultural industry and within a multinational company environment will be preferred; experience in manufacturing, FMCG, export-focused business, and project management will be advantageous;
• Strong computer proficiency (Advanced MS Excel, ERP and financial reporting systems).

The Company Secretarial function supports a complex, multi-entity governance environment with stringent regulatory and compliance requirements.
The primary objective of this role is to provide administrative, statutory and governance support to the Group Company Secretary and the broader Company Secretariat function. The role assists in ensuring that group entities comply with applicable statutory, regulatory and governance requirements, and supports the effective administration of board and committee processes. This is an administrative company secretarial role, positioned at Officer level because it requires practical experience, sound drafting ability, strong system exposure and the ability to work under pressure in a high-volume environment.
Key responsibilities
• Assist with the preparation and coordination of board and committee meetings, including compiling agendas and board packs, circulating meeting materials, and managing logistics.
• Maintain and update board and committee records, including minutes, resolutions, attendance registers, and action trackers.
• Support the preparation of draft minutes and ensure accurate recording, review and filing of meeting outcomes.
• Maintain statutory registers and company records for all group entities, including directors, shareholders and shareholding changes.
• Assist with the preparation and submission of CIPC filings and other regulatory submissions, including annual returns, director changes and related corporate actions.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date entity records on company secretarial systems, including ProfSoft or equivalent systems.
• Coordinate the execution of resolutions and other governance documentation.
• Assist with the administration of shareholder meetings, including preparation of notices and supporting documentation.
• Ensure proper filing, storage and version control of governance and statutory documents.
• Track and follow up on board and committee action items and governance deadlines.
• Liaise with internal stakeholders, directors' offices, auditors and external service providers on administrative and coordination matters.
• Support clean-up of legacy records, historical company secretarial information, statutory registers and governance documentation.
• Provide general administrative and secretarial support to the Group Company Secretary and Company Secretariat function
Systems Experience
The candidate must have practical experience using, or meaningful exposure to, the following systems and portals:
• ProfSoft
• Diligent Boards
• SharePoint
• Microsoft 365
• DocuSign
• CIPC eServices
• Companies Registry portals (regional jurisdictions)
Qualifications and Experience
• A relevant diploma, certificate or degree in Law, Governance, Business Administration, Commerce or a related field.
• 1–4 years' experience in a company secretarial, legal, governance, compliance or administrative support role. Candidates with stronger practical company secretarial administration experience may also be considered.

job_title: Accounts Clerk/ Creditors Clerk – Foreign Accounts
about_role:
To accurately process and maintain foreign supplier and international transaction accounts, ensuring timely payments, reconciliations, compliance with company policies, and adherence to foreign exchange and financial regulations. The role involves processing and reconciling foreign creditor accounts, capturing invoices and credit notes, and ensuring accurate allocation of payments. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring outstanding balances, assisting with credit control for foreign suppliers, and preparing reconciliations and reports for the finance team. The Accounts Clerk/Creditors Clerk will also manage cash transactions, support month-end closing activities, and maintain proper filing and documentation of all relevant accounting records. Collaboration with internal departments and external suppliers to resolve queries and ensure timely payments is an important part of this position.
Key Responsibilities
Accounts Payable
• Process invoices received from foreign suppliers and service providers.
• Verify invoice accuracy, supporting documentation, and approval requirements.
• Prepare and process foreign currency payments within agreed payment terms.
• Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on discrepancies. Reconciliations
• Reconcile foreign supplier statements monthly.
• Investigate and resolve account variances and payment discrepancies.
• Reconcile foreign currency bank accounts as required.   Foreign Exchange Administration
• Record foreign currency transactions accurately.
• Daily capturing of credit notes on the system.
• FICA documentations collection
• Monitor exchange rate differences and assist with forex adjustments.
• Maintain records related to foreign payments and currency conversions. Financial Record Keeping
• Maintain accurate accounting records and supplier files.
• Capture transactions into the accounting system promptly.
• Ensure all documentation is filed and retained according to company procedures. Compliance & Reporting
• Ensure compliance with company financial policies and procedures.
• Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation.
• Prepare periodic reports on foreign accounts, payments, and outstanding balances. General Finance Support
• Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.
• Support the Finance Department with administrative and accounting tasks.
• Provide excellent service to internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

We are looking for a sharp, versatile content professional who can research and write exceptionally well and design learning content beautifully.
This role is ideal for someone who sits at the intersection of research, writing, learning, Content development and design — whether your background is in copywriting, content development, graphic design, instructional design, or a related field. What matters most is that you can take complex ideas, shape them into clear learning content, and present them in a way that is engaging, intelligent, polished and effective for the target audience.
You will help us create and improve learning material used in online, virtual and in-person learning environments. This includes everything from slide decks, workbooks and facilitator material to digital learning elements, filmed products and platform-based content.
We need someone who is both conceptually strong and creatively capable — someone who can think clearly, write with precision, structure learning effectively, and produce content that looks professional and lands well with the audience.
What you will do
• Develop, update and maintain learning content and learning elements for a wide range of Raizcorp programmes and interventions
• Research newly assigned topics, subjects, or concepts, and develop a structured learning framework and key concepts for them.
• Create content for both virtual and face-to-face learning experiences
• Write, edit and refine learning material so that it is Effective, clear, engaging and aligned to purpose
• Design and format learning content so that it is visually strong, easy to use and professional
• Review content developed by others, including internal stakeholders, external service providers and AI-supported outputs
• Help maintain and improve instructional design standards, processes and templates
• Manage the development flow of learning content, including tracking progress and coordinating with subcontractors where required
• Contribute to digital learning content for internal platforms and learning products
• Update slide decks, manuals, learning elements and related content assets
• Conduct research and contribute fresh ideas to improve the quality and impact of our learning design
• Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into revised content
• Support the maintenance of learning dashboards and content development systems
What we are looking for
• At least 5 years’ experience in content development, learning design, instructional design, copywriting, editorial work, graphic design, or a related field
• Strong academic performance in English at school or tertiary level.
• A relevant 3-year qualification in fields such as writing, communications, education, instructional design, graphic design, multimedia design, marketing, language practice, journalism, or similar
• Ability to interpret scanned briefs and translate them into appropriate outputs through targeted questioning
• A strong portfolio of work that shows your writing ability, thinking ability and design capability
• Excellent written English and the ability to write clearly, intelligently and professionally
• Strong visual design ability and the ability to create polished, well-structured content
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Suite
• Confidence using AI tools such as ChatGPT to support content development and refinement
• A sound understanding of how adults learn, how content should flow, and how to make learning practical and engaging
• At least a basic understanding of business and commercial concepts
• Strong planning, organisation and deadline management
The kind of person who will do well in this role
• You are intellectually strong and enjoy working with ideas
• You can take complexity and turn it into something clear
• You care about words, structure, flow and presentation
• You are creative, but also disciplined and detail-oriented
• You can work at pace without losing quality
• You are comfortable giving feedback, receiving feedback and improving work collaboratively
• You build trust easily and can work well with a range of stakeholders
• You take ownership and have a strong standard for what good work looks likeWhy this role matters
This role plays an important part in shaping the quality of learning experiences across the business. The content you develop will influence how people learn, engage, and apply what they have been taught. It is therefore important that you can combine strong thinking, strong writing and strong design in one role.
If you are someone who can write with clarity, design with intent, and build learning that is both smart and practical, we would like to hear from you.

Designed for driven, results-focused individuals who want to succeed.

• Ongoing training and development

The Accountant – Finance Shared Services is responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely and consistent recording, reconciliation and reporting of operating expenses across multiple business entities. The role plays a key part in delivering an efficient month-end close, maintaining the integrity of the financial statements, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and company policies, and providing meaningful financial insights that support informed business decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Accounting & Month-End Close
• Process and maintain accurate accounting records for operating expenses across multiple entities.
• Execute month-end close activities in accordance with finance reporting deadlines (BD1–BD5).
• Prepare and post journals, accruals, prepayments and reallocations.
• Ensure all expenses are accurately recorded within the correct accounting period.
• Monitor daily financial transactions and investigate unusual or incomplete postings.
• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations.
• Investigate and resolve reconciling items within agreed timelines.
• Maintain supporting documentation for all reconciliations.
• Ensure balance sheet integrity through regular review and analysis.
Financial Analysis & Reporting
• Analyse operating expenses and identify material variances.
• Investigate unexpected movements and determine root causes.
• Provide clear commentary and explanations for monthly financial results.
• Support Finance Managers with financial analysis and reporting requirements.
• Highlight risks, missing costs and opportunities for improvement.
• Ensure compliance with IFRS, the Companies Act, tax regulations and internal accounting policies.
• Support internal and external audit requirements.
• Maintain strong financial controls and governance processes.
• Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
Shared Services Operations
• Support multiple business entities within the Finance Shared Services environment.
• Assist team members during peak reporting periods.
• Maintain standardised accounting processes across all supported entities.
• Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
Stakeholder Support
• Build strong working relationships with Finance Managers and business stakeholders.
• Respond to finance queries accurately and within agreed service levels.
• Provide financial insights that assist operational decision-making.
• Communicate financial information clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
• Deliver timely and accurate month-end financial close (BD1–BD5).
• Maintain high levels of accuracy across journals, reconciliations and financial reporting.
• Complete balance sheet reconciliations within reporting deadlines.
• Identify and resolve financial discrepancies promptly.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards, company policies and governance requirements.
• Support effective collaboration across the Finance Shared Services team.
• Deliver meaningful financial commentary and variance analysis.
Minimum Qualifications
• BCom Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
Experience Required
• Minimum 3 years' experience in a finance or accounting role.
• Experience within a shared services environment would be advantageous.
• Completed audit articles will be considered beneficial.
• Experience preparing month-end journals, reconciliations and financial reporting.
• Exposure to ERP systems such as Syspro or similar financial systems.
• Strong understanding of financial accounting principles.
• Knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting standards.
• Experience with balance sheet reconciliations and income statement analysis.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
• ERP system experience (Syspro or equivalent).
• Strong financial reporting and analytical capabilities.
Core Competencies
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Sound technical accounting knowledge.
• Effective time management and ability to meet tight reporting deadlines.
• Strong process discipline and commitment to compliance.
• Proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
• Excellent communication and business partnering skills.
• High level of systems proficiency and financial reporting capability.
• Collaborative team player who supports colleagues across multiple entities.
• Ability to manage competing priorities within a fast-paced shared services environment.

Business Development Executive
Johannesburg | Full-time | Office-based
This isn’t your typical sales role. It’s an opportunity to build real wealth, grow your influence, and make a tangible impact on the South African economy.
At Raizcorp, we’re not focused on pushing products. We partner with corporates to solve meaningful challenges while helping build the country’s next generation of businesses.
Every deal you close supports real entrepreneurs.
Every client you bring in drives measurable change.
And because clients renew annually, you keep earning from the relationships you build.
Why this role exists
We’re looking for high-performing business development professionals who are comfortable operating at a C-suite level, navigating complex environments, and closing high-value, solution-driven deals.
This is strategic, consultative B2B sales—not transactional selling.
If you’re a natural hunter, a strong closer, and someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment, this role offers a platform to grow both your income and your career in a meaningful way.
What you’ll be doing
You’ll take full ownership of the sales cycle - from identifying opportunities to closing deals and growing long-term client relationships:
• Winning new business
Identifying and securing corporate clients through targeted outreach, networking, and relationship-building.
• Selling tailored solutions
Understanding client needs and designing customised Enterprise & Supplier Development (ESD), Skills Development, and SED solutions.
• Engaging senior decision-makers
Working directly with CEOs, CFOs, procurement leaders, and transformation executives.
• Closing meaningful deals
Leading negotiations, presenting compelling proposals, and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.
• Building a long-term client base
Strengthening relationships, driving renewals, and identifying upsell opportunities—earning ongoing commission.
• Representing Raizcorp
Acting as a trusted advisor and brand ambassador in the corporate space.
What makes this role different
• Annuity-based commission model
You don’t just earn once—your income grows as your clients renew year after year.
• Work with real impact
Your success directly contributes to job creation, economic growth, and transformation.
• Structured training
No prior B-BBEE or ESD experience needed—we’ll equip you with the expertise.
• True solution selling
You’re not selling products—you’re delivering strategic outcomes.
• A high-performance environment
Designed for driven, results-focused individuals who want to succeed.
What we’re looking for
This is a selective role, suited to experienced professionals who can perform at a high level.
Non-negotiables:
• Proven experience in B2B / corporate / solution sales (typically 3 - 5+ years)
• A strong track record of closing high-value deals
• Experience working with senior decision-makers
• Solid pipeline management and forecasting skills
• High levels of drive, resilience, and accountability
You’ll do well if:
• You’re a natural hunter with strong closing ability
• You think strategically, not just transactionally
• You understand business and can engage at a commercial level
• You’re confident in a boardroom environment
• You’re motivated by performance-based earnings rather than capped salaries
What you’ll get
• Competitive base salary plus a highly rewarding, annuity-based commission structure
• Ongoing training and development
• Access to Salesforce CRM and full operational support
• Exposure to leading corporate clients
• A career path that grows with your performance
The opportunity
This is a role where:
• Your income builds year after year
• Your client base becomes a long-term asset
• Your work contributes to meaningful national impact
If you’re ready to step up and perform at a higher level, apply now.
Join Raizcorp and build something that truly matters.

Raizcorp is looking for a seasoned, well-rounded business professional with superior commercial acumen to join as a business coach. Your day-to-day will be coaching a portfolio of entrepreneurs across all spheres of their business: strategy, sales, marketing, finance, and the entrepreneurs’ personal development journey. This is a full-time, salaried coaching role, not a consulting contract. You won’t do the work for them; you’ll equip them to do it themselves through a structured methodology and ongoing guidance.
You don’t need prior coaching experience - Raizcorp will invest in equipping you with this competence. We need your strong business acumen, an empathetic approach to entrepreneurs, and a genuine desire to create impact.
What you’ll do
• Hold one-on-one coaching sessions, run business simulations, and facilitate group learning (following a proven programme that transfers skill, builds capability, and improves business results).
• Manage a defined portfolio of entrepreneurs, tracking impact on revenue, profitability, and founder growth over time.
• Orchestrate inputs across disciplines (strategy, sales, marketing, finance, people) so entrepreneurs make integrated, forward-looking decisions.
• Stay sharp on economic shifts and relevant regulations that affect entrepreneurs, and surface implications in coaching conversations.
• Work collaboratively with other coaches in both team structures and one-on-one scenarios.
Who you are
• A business all-rounder with 10 to 15+ years’ experience across corporate and entrepreneurial settings. You must have your own businesses at some point (this is non-negotiable).
• Commercially fluent across strategy, sales, marketing, and finance, able to connect the dots and coach trade-offs. You need to bring real experiential depth and gravitas in business finance, strategy, and sales.
• High emotional intelligence with genuine empathy for the highs and lows of the entrepreneurial journey; mature, accountable, and non-judgemental.
• A crisp communicator who is organised, systematic, proactive, and deadline reliable.
• Competent and experienced with technology and systems (Microsoft 365/Office and learner management systems).
• Qualifications: A commerce-related tertiary qualification (MBA or master’s-level qualification an advantage).
• Driver’s licence and own car essential.
What you’ll get
• The leverage to change real businesses at scale with measurable bottom-line impact.
• Formal training in an internationally recognised coaching methodology and continuous professional development.
• A fiercely caring team culture that backs the jockey (the entrepreneur), not just the horse.
• A rare opportunity to work with entrepreneurs and their businesses every day.
Important to know
This is a coaching role, not consulting. We don’t write our entrepreneurs’ plans or do their work.  Instead, we build their capability and hold them accountable through a structured programme. Remuneration is aligned to the professional coaching market, reflecting the full-time, portfolio-based nature of the work.

about_role:
Meridian Wine Distribution (MWD) is looking for an experienced and customer-focused Customer Service Operations Lead to lead our Customer Service function, drive service excellence, and develop a high-performing team that delivers outstanding customer experiences in Gauteng.
About Meridian Wine Distribution (MWD)
Meridian Wine Distribution (MWD) is one of South Africa's leading wine and beverage distribution businesses, delivering exceptional service, operational excellence, and customer-focused supply chain solutions to customers across the country.
Our success is built on passionate people, trusted partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to delivering the right products to the right customers at the right time.
Job Responsibilities
Customer Service Leadership
• Lead the day-to-day operations of the Customer Service function.
• Allocate workloads and monitor team performance and service delivery.
• Coach, mentor, and support Customer Service Agents to achieve operational excellence.

• Manage customer escalations and implement effective resolutions.
• Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve service delivery.Order Management

• Coordinate customer communications relating to stock availability and deliveries.
• Support new customer onboarding and service implementation activities.
• Contribute to business-wide continuous improvement initiatives.Leadership & People Development

Role Purpose
Own the strategic relationship, experience outcomes and sustainable growth of an assigned portfolio of key employer and institutional clients. The Key Account Manager is the accountable client-facing lead who translates the Salt EB value proposition into measurable client value, protects retention, identifies growth opportunities and mobilises the business to deliver on commitments.
The role combines strategic account management, client-experience leadership, commercial discipline and delivery governance. It requires proactive management of executive stakeholders, accurate insight-led decision-making and disciplined follow-through across the full client lifecycle.
Business Plan Alignment
The role directly enables the Experience Unit business plan by converting client insight into retention, growth and service-improvement actions. The role is expected to contribute to the following business outcomes:
• Protect and grow strategic accounts through trusted executive relationships, structured account plans and targeted expansion of Salt EB solutions.
• Improve the end-to-end employer and member experience by reducing service friction, improving responsiveness and driving meaningful resolution of recurring pain points.
• Advance financial inclusion and shared-value outcomes through relevant, accessible employee-benefit solutions and client interventions.
• Drive operational excellence and digital adoption by championing self-service, data quality, process simplification and efficient hand-offs between teams.
• Embed an accountable, data-led and risk-aware operating model through consistent CRM discipline, service-performance reporting, contract governance and action tracking.
Key Accountabilities
1. Strategic Account Leadership and Stakeholder Management
• Serve as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts, building strong relationships with executive sponsors, HR leaders, trustees, advisers and operational contacts.
• Develop and maintain account plans, stakeholder maps, account-health assessments, opportunity pipelines and client-specific value propositions aligned to the annual business plan.
• Conduct disciplined quarterly business reviews and executive engagements that communicate performance, insight, risks, opportunities, agreed actions and value delivered.
• Anticipate client needs, market developments and competitor activity; translate these into proactive retention, remediation, solution-development and growth actions.
• Ensure all account commitments, decisions, risks, commercial opportunities and escalation actions are accurately documented, owned and tracked to closure.
2. Client Experience, Service Delivery and Escalation Management
• Own the overall experience of the assigned client portfolio, using client feedback, complaints, service data and qualitative insight to identify moments that matter and improve outcomes.
• Coordinate cross-functional delivery across administration, operations, technology, product, finance, legal/compliance and other teams to meet contractual commitments, SLAs and agreed client expectations.
• Lead the resolution of material client issues and executive escalations; establish recovery plans with clear owners, deadlines, communication cadences and evidence of closure.
• Convert recurring service failures and manual workarounds into root-cause analysis, process-improvement and digital-enablement initiatives.
• Ensure client communications are accurate, timely, professional and aligned to Salt EB standards and approved messaging.
3. Portfolio Growth, Commercialisation and Shared Value
• Identify and qualify opportunities to retain, deepen and expand each relationship, including cross-sell, solution adoption, funded interventions and relevant financial-inclusion initiatives.
• Build business cases for account-growth, experience-improvement and client-intervention initiatives, including anticipated benefits, costs, risks, dependencies and return on investment.
• Partner with sales, product and leadership teams to shape and deliver commercially viable proposals that address client objectives and support sustainable portfolio profitability.
• Monitor account financial performance, contract milestones, renewal dates, pipeline conversion and initiative ROI; escalate exceptions early and recommend corrective action.
• Manage approved account-development, campaign, incentive and expense budgets within delegated authority and agreed controls.
4. Data, Insight and Performance Management
• Use account, service, engagement and financial data to diagnose performance, identify trends and prioritise interventions that improve client outcomes and business value.
• Maintain complete, accurate and current CRM/account records, including contacts, contractual details, pipeline, interactions, commitments, incidents, actions and client feedback.
• Prepare concise, decision-ready account reports, dashboards and presentations for internal management, client executive forums and trustee meetings where required.
• Track agreed key performance indicators, root-cause themes, client commitments and benefits realisation; provide early warning of delivery, retention or commercial risk.
• Contribute client insight and market intelligence to the Experience Unit roadmap, product enhancement, service design and continuous-improvement agenda.
5. Governance, Risk and Compliance
• Ensure that account activities comply with contractual obligations, approved policies, data-protection requirements, conduct standards and applicable financial-services or retirement-fund governance requirements.
• Maintain effective control of client documentation, approvals, meeting records, account plans and decision logs in the designated systems and repositories.
• Identify, assess and escalate client, operational, conduct, data and reputational risks; ensure mitigation actions are documented, actioned and monitored.
• Support audit, quality-assurance and governance reviews by providing accurate evidence, responding to findings and closing agreed corrective actions within required timeframes.
6. Collaboration, Accountability and Continuous Improvement
• Lead virtual account teams with clear outcomes, roles, milestones and service expectations, despite having no direct reports.
• Hold internal stakeholders accountable for agreed client deliverables, escalating capacity, dependency or delivery risk promptly and constructively.
• Champion a client-led, ownership-driven culture in which issues are resolved at source, commitments are honoured and lessons learned are embedded into improved ways of working.
• Contribute to standardising account-management practices, playbooks, reporting and client-engagement routines across the Experience Unit.
Knowledge, Skills and Competencies
• Strategic account management, executive stakeholder engagement and client-retention practices.
• Client-experience principles, service recovery, complaint management and continuous improvement.
• Commercial acumen: account economics, value propositions, budgets, business cases and return-on-investment analysis.
• Data literacy and performance reporting, including confident use of CRM, Excel and presentation tools.
• Sound knowledge of employee benefits, retirement funds and/or the broader financial-services environment is preferred.
• Project and change-management capability, with the ability to coordinate multiple internal stakeholders and competing priorities.
• Strong written, verbal and presentation communication skills; ability to simplify complex information for executive audiences.
• High personal accountability, judgement, resilience, attention to detail and commitment to deadlines, governance and professional conduct.
Key Behavioural Expectations
• Client obsessed: starts with the client and member impact, and balances this with sustainable commercial outcomes.
• Accountable: takes ownership of commitments, follows through

As our Group SOX Control Analyst, you’ll play a key role in supporting the execution of the Group's Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance programme by assisting in the design, documentation, testing and monitoring of Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR). Working closely with the Group SOX Controller and business stakeholders, you will help identify and assess financial reporting risks, evaluate controls, support audit activities, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the control environment.
This role provides operational and analytical support across all financial SOX controls including but not limited to, Information Produced by the Entity (IPE), and SOX-related project activities.
Risk Assessment & Scoping
• Identify and assess key financial reporting risks.
• Assist with the annual SOX scoping and risk assessment exercises
• Control Design & Framework Enhancement
• Support the design and implementation of controls aligned to COSO and PCAOB principles
• Review control design to ensure sufficient precision to mitigate financial reporting risks
• Assess the adequacy of existing control structures and recommend improvements
• Drive continuous improvement of the SOX control framework
• Support the integration of controls into new systems, processes, or business initiatives
SOX Assessments and Testing
• Perform Design Effectiveness (DE) and Operating Effectiveness (OE) testing of SOX controls to assess whether controls are implemented as designed and operating effectively across the Group
• Assess the SOX implications of changes due to Accounting or regulatory updates, Process or policy changes, System implementations or enhancements or Organisational restructuring.
• Prepare high-quality audit working papers and maintain complete supporting documentation.
• Partner with stakeholders to ensure controls evolve alongside business changes
• Track testing progress and follow up on outstanding evidence with control owners.
• Documenting testing exceptions, assess control deficiencies/observations, including root cause analysis and support practical and sustainable remediation actions that mitigate financial reporting risks.
• Monitor remediation activities and validate corrective actions where required, including remediation testing.
• Collaborate with control owners to reinforce expectations around control execution and documentation quality.
Governance & Audit Support
• Prepare documentation for walkthroughs and control discussions.
• Updating and maintaining Process Narratives/Process Flow Charts and Risk and Control Matrices (RACMs).
• Liaise with IT Control teams regarding dependencies between IT General Controls, IT Automated Controls and Business Process Controls.
• Maintain documentation standards and version control.
• Assist with periodic SOX reporting and dashboard preparation.
• Support external and internal audit requests
• Coordinate evidence requests
Continuous Improvement
• Review and enhance documentation to ensure consistency and clarity across the Group
• Identify opportunities to improve and standardise SOX processes and documentation across business units/entities.
• Support the development of templates, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
• Assist with maintaining process documentation and knowledge repositories.
• Contribute to automation and data analytics initiatives that improve SOX testing and reporting efficiency.
• Keep up to date with changes in SOX, COSO, PCAOB, and emerging financial reporting risks.
• Provide insights into control effectiveness and programme maturity
• Promote awareness of controls best practices across the organisation

Experience

The IT Infrastructure Consultant is responsible for designing and tailoring IT infrastructure architectures that support public transport technology solutions. The role interprets solution-specific infrastructure standards and designs client-specific environments that meet system requirements as well as client operational, security, and performance needs. This position requires strong expertise in virtualization, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, high availability, networking, and hybrid/cloud infrastructure within mission-critical environments.
Key Responsibilities
Solution-Based Infrastructure Design
Design infrastructure architectures aligned with defined transport system requirements such as AFC, fare management, fleet management, RTPI, and control centre systems. Translate system infrastructure standards into client-specific designs. Assess client environments and identify gaps between existing infrastructure and solution requirements. Produce High-Level Designs (HLD) and Low-Level Designs (LLD) aligned with performance, availability, scalability, security, and integration requirements.
Client Environment Assessment
Conduct infrastructure assessments of client data centres, cloud platforms, and network environments. Evaluate compute, storage, virtualization, topology, and security posture. Identify risks, dependencies, and readiness gaps. Provide recommendations and remediation plans.

Design virtualized server environments aligned with sizing requirements. Architect hybrid or cloud deployments where required. Ensure appropriate resource sizing for CPU, memory, storage, and IOPS. Security and Compliance
Ensure infrastructure aligns with cybersecurity best practices and transport authority standards. Incorporate identity management, encryption, endpoint protection, and network security controls. Support compliance with data protection and payment security standards such as PCI-DSS. Maintain awareness of emerging security threats and technologies.
Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
Design Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity strategies aligned with RPO and RTO requirements. Implement backup, replication, and failover solutions. Ensure resilience levels for mission-critical systems. Participate in recovery testing and validation exercises.
Stakeholder and Pre-Sales Engagement
Provide infrastructure expertise during solution design and bid processes. Present architectures to technical and executive stakeholders. Support clarification of architecture requirements during implementation. Collaborate with software, implementation, and project teams.

• Work closely with the Brand & Social teams to ensure consistent and effective acquisition messaging.

We are an established health and wellness ecommerce brand looking for a top-tier Ad Editor to join our team long term. This is not a short contract or a one-off project. We are building a brand for the long run and want serious talent that is ready to grow with us.

As our Ad Editor, you will be responsible for editing high-performing video ads used across paid traffic channels. Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.
You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine — you'll own that side of the creative machine.
What Success Looks Like
Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process — creatives that pass review without rework and match the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.

• Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

About Exchange Life
Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. We run a fully remote content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across the world.
We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals — not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us for 2+ years.
You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.
What Success Looks Like
After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form videos that scale on ads and organic — 50%+ thumb-stop rates, 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.

job_title: Full-Time Remote Video Editor — AI Video Ads (Kling + AI Tools) for a US Ecommerce Brand
about_role:
FULL-TIME REMOTE VIDEO EDITOR — AI VIDEO ADS FOR A US ECOMMERCE BRAND
We are a US-based ecommerce company hiring full-time remote video editors to produce short video ads (30–60 seconds) for Facebook and Instagram. This is a long-term, permanent full-time position — we are looking for people who want stable work with one company, not a short project. We are hiring MORE THAN ONE editor for this role. Work is fully remote.
THE ROLE
You will receive a complete package for every ad: a finished script, a creative brief, and example videos showing the style to match. Your job is to turn that package into a finished video ad:
- Generate AI video clips using image-to-video tools (we use Kling via Higgsfield — we provide all accounts and all tools, you pay for nothing)
- Generate the starting images for those clips with AI image tools, using prompts you develop with our AI assistant
- Source real B-roll clips from TikTok, YouTube, and similar platforms where the shot calls for it
- Generate the voiceover with AI (ElevenLabs) from the provided script
- Assemble everything in the editing software you are most comfortable with (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, etc.): edit to the voiceover, add captions, add music, export
- Each ad is delivered as three versions with different openings (we will train you on our exact method — it is fast once learned)
You do not write scripts and you do not need marketing knowledge. We provide the script, the brief, and the reference videos. You provide clean, fast, good-looking execution. Work is assigned and tracked through a simple board — you always know exactly what to work on next.
SCHEDULE AND PAY
Full-time, 8 hours per day, Monday to Saturday. USD $600–$1,200 per month depending on experience, fixed, paid reliably every month. Real opportunity for pay growth as your output proves itself — we are building a long-term creative team and this role grows with the company.
HOW TO APPLY
Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that skip any step will not be read.
1. Start your application message with the word KINGFISHER on the first line.
2. Include a link to your portfolio or showreel.
3. List the AI video/image tools you have personally used and one sentence on what you made with each. If you have used Claude or another AI assistant, say so and tell us what for.
4. Confirm you are available full-time, Monday to Saturday, and are applying as an individual.
5. Answer this short exercise. Imagine you are producing a video ad from a script we gave you. Four situations come up. For each one, tell us which ONE action you would take and give one sentence explaining why.
a) One line of the script feels awkward to you and you think you could word it better. Do you: REWRITE IT / FLAG IT AND BUILD IT AS WRITTEN / SKIP THAT LINE?
b) The example video we gave you for style reference features a well-known influencer talking to camera. Do you: CLIP HER FOOTAGE INTO OUR AD / RECREATE THE SAME STYLE OF SHOT WITH AN AI-GENERATED PERSON / ASK US TO LICENSE HER FOOTAGE?
c) An AI-generated clip looks great except the person's hands are warped. Do you: SHIP IT, VIEWERS WON'T NOTICE / REGENERATE THE CLIP WITH A FIXED PROMPT / CROP THE HANDS OUT IF POSSIBLE, OTHERWISE REGENERATE?
d) You need a generic clip of a dog running in a park and can't find good free footage. Do you: LEAVE THAT SHOT OUT / GENERATE IT WITH AI / USE A CLIP THAT ALMOST FITS?
Shortlisted candidates will have a short video interview, and final candidates will complete a SHORT PAID test project (we pay you for it). We read every application that follows the instructions.

job_title: Wine Sales Specialist Consultant | Meridian Wine Merchants | Gauteng
about_role:
Meridian Wine Merchants is currently seeking a passionate and results-driven individual to join our team as a Wine Sales Specialist Consultant. At Meridian Wine Merchants, we expertly combine tradition and innovation to provide outstanding products tailored to our diverse clients. This position is based in Gauteng.
Duties and Responsibilities
• Identify, develop and convert new premium business opportunities while growing premium wine sales, profitability and portfolio performance across allocated territories.
• Develop annual customer growth plans, identify new premium opportunities, and implement initiatives that expand premium category sales.
• Execute wine list recommendations, premium portfolio placements, and listing opportunities within targeted customer segments and outlets.
• Proactively identify, prospect and convert new premium restaurants, hotels, hospitality groups and specialist wine customers within the allocated territory.
• Develop trusted long-term client relationships that position Meridian as the preferred premium wine partner while expanding customer value.
• Conduct customer-led trade visits to identify execution opportunities, customer requirements, visibility gaps, and portfolio growth opportunities.
• Lead premium tastings, winemaker dinners, customer events and educational experiences that generate new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships.
• Develop customer-specific growth plans by identifying premium category opportunities, menu opportunities, new listings and premium portfolio expansion opportunities.
• Review customer wine offerings, identify gaps and growth opportunities, recommend commercially successful wine selections, and establish premium category standards.
• Gather and communicate customer insights, competitor activity, wine list trends, and regional market intelligence to support strategic commercial decisions.
• Identify new premium trading areas, emerging customer segments and untapped market opportunities for future business growth.
• Execute customer and portfolio segmentation strategies to ensure the right portfolio mix within the right customer environments.
• Execute cycle briefs, premium trade initiatives, promotional campaigns, and activation plans in conjunction with Trade Marketing and the Wine Specialist Manager.
• Work closely with Distribution, Trade Marketing, Key Accounts, Sales Reps, Finance, and internal support teams to ensure product availability and operational execution.
• Coach Sales Representatives on premium portfolio positioning, customer opportunities and premium selling techniques.
• Deliver premium wine education, food pairing guidance and category development sessions that strengthen customer capability and drive premium wine sales.
• Ensure disciplined usage and maintenance of Repforce, Truedata, reporting tools, and customer databases.
• Continuously maintain and improve wine, competitor, portfolio, commercial and premium category knowledge.
Requirements
• Grade 12 (Matric) plus Cape Wine Academy Wine Certificate
• Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FMCG liquor sales and merchandising across premium customer environments
• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, CG Cloud) advantageous
• Valid driver’s licence, own reliable vehicle, and right to work in South Africa
Why Join Meridian?
Meridian Wine Merchants connects some of South Africa's most exciting premium wine brands with the country's leading restaurants, retailers, hotels and wine professionals. Every day is an opportunity to learn, grow and make an impact in an industry we're passionate about.
We're a team that works hard, celebrates success and is always looking for better ways to do things. We value people who bring energy, curiosity, integrity and a genuine love for wine. Here, your ideas matter, your contribution is recognised, and your growth is part of our success.
If you're passionate about premium wine, thrive in a fast-moving environment and want to build a career where you'll be challenged, supported and inspired every day, come and grow with us.

about_role:
National Brands Limited (NBL), a leading subsidiary of AVI Limited, is one of South Africa’s top FMCG companies with iconic brands like Willards, Bakers, Five Roses, and House of Coffees. For over 173 years, NBL has been a key player in the South African food sector, expanding its reach across Southern Africa and delivering high-quality products that impact daily lives.
At NBL, we embrace a culture of high standards, teamwork, and accountability. Our employees are driven by excellence and innovation, always prioritising customer satisfaction. We celebrate our South African roots and foster a workplace where collaboration thrive.
Step Into a Role That Makes an Impact! We’re seeking a Office Services and Maintenance Manager to drive success NBL Head Office in Bryanston, Johannesburg. This role is designed to ensure ensure maximum, efficient operation of facilities and equipment, as well as the care of the Bryanston Campus building, grounds and support equipment, through the direction of support staff made up of supervisors, technicians and custodians.  Develops and maintains preventative maintenance programs. Sets priorities for projects and enforces safety and housekeeping practices.
Reporting Structure:
• Reports to: AVI Exco Project Manager
• Direct Reports: Maintenance Supervisor, Post room Supervisor / Post room attendant and driver, 2x Baristas, Telephonist, Staff shop and AdministrationKey Areas of Impact:
Ensure a functional, safe and compliant facilities infrastructure:
• Minimise operational, safety, and infrastructure risk across the Bryanston Campus
• Ensure compliance with all relevant legislation, standards, and internal governance requirements relating to facilities and building infrastructure.
• Maintain oversight of statutory inspections, certifications, and compliance documentation.
• Identify and escalate risks timeously, ensuring corrective actions are implemented and tracked.
• Stay informed of technical developments, legislative changes, and industry best practices affecting facilities management.
• Ensure prompt logging, tracking, and resolution of all maintenance requests and complaints.
• Implement structured reactive and preventive maintenance processes.
• Monitor building systems including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, and fire services.
• Identify infrastructure risks and implement corrective and preventative actions.
• Ensure operational continuity and minimise business disruption.
• Compile monthly Facilities Report which documents all of the above mentioned items. Asset Management:
• Ensure the effective, efficient and optimal utilisation of all facilities assets in line with asset-care principles.
• Implement and maintain planned and preventive maintenance schedules to protect asset condition and extend useful life.
• Monitor asset performance and condition to support proactive maintenance and replacement planning.
• Prepare and manage asset replacement forecasts and lifecycle budgets in alignment with business planning cycles.
• Identify and implement cost-saving and value-optimisation opportunities without compromising safety or service levels.
• Review and verify supplier quotations, variation orders, and final invoices to ensure accuracy.
• Monitor, track and record the movements of assets.
• Monitor and maintain records of warranties, service contracts, compliance certificates, and maintenance history.Ensure compliance to Health and Safety in line with OHSA:
• Ensure ongoing compliance with OHSA and related statutory requirements.
• Maintain emergency preparedness and business continuity plans, including documentation, drills, and reviews.
• Monitor, investigate, and report all facilities-related incidents and alerts to Executive Management.
• Ensure appointment and training of health and safety representatives, fire marshals, and first aiders.
• Ensure completion of monthly safety inspections and statutory meetings.
• Support audits, risk assessments, and corrective action tracking.Ensure a safe, neat and hygienic working environment for staff:
• Manage daily campus operations to ensure a safe, clean and efficient working environment.
• Conduct regular inspections and audits, ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
• Ensure facilities requests and complaints are logged and resolved timeously.
• Source vendors, obtain quotations and recommend preferred suppliers.
• Coordinate weekend and after-hours contractor activities.
• Manage campus-wide communications related to facilities operations.
• Maintain up-to-date campus documentation, site guides and SOPs.Ensure Accurate Reporting and Financial Control (budgets and actuals):
• Prepare and manage operational budgets, including day-to-day costs, revise monthly building expenditure.
• Monitor monthly expenditure and update forecasts.
• Analyse and report budget variances to the AVI Exco Projects Manager.
• Review and approve invoices to ensure cost accuracy and budget compliance.
• Maintain accurate financial reporting and audit documentation. Delivery of ad-hoc projects:
• Plan and deliver ad-hoc facilities projects in line with business requirements.
• Manage scope, cost, quality, timelines and contractor performance.
• Ensure compliance with safety, governance and procurement standards.
• Coordinate stakeholder communication and project close-out documentationEffective team management:
• Lead and manage the facilities team to ensure effective service delivery.
• Set performance objectives and conduct regular performance reviews (set IPA’s, Mid year and Year End reviews, manage poor performance).
• Identify training and development needs.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and safety standards.
• Promote teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement. Knowledge and Skills:
• Health and Safety Audit Knowledge
• Facilities Management Protocols and Procedures
• Knowledge of OHSACT
• Project planning, delivery management
• Budgeting and Financial Management
• Asset Management

African Parks is a non-profit conservation organization that takes on the complete responsibility for the rehabilitation and long-term management of national parks in partnership with governments and local communities. We currently manage 23 national parks and protected areas in 13 countries covering over 20 million hectares in: Angola, Benin, Central African Republic, Chad, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Malawi, Mozambique, Republic of Congo, Rwanda, Zambia, Zimbabwe, South Sudan and Ethiopia.
The Great Nile Migration Landscape (GNML) in South Sudan spans over 120,000 km² across Badingilo and Boma National Parks, Jonglei State, and adjoining community lands. It forms one of Africa’s most important ecological systems, connecting the Sudd wetlands in the west to the Boma highlands in the east. The landscape supports extraordinary biodiversity, including the largest land mammal migration on earth comprising around 6 million animals.

job_title: Agricultural Valuation & Machine Learning Model SME
about_role:
Our client in the banking industry is looking for an Agricultural Valuation SME to join their team!
Role Purpose
• The Agricultural Valuation & Machine Learning Model SME will provide specialist advisory, research, and knowledge management services to support the development, validation, and interpretation of machine learning-driven agricultural valuation models.
• The role bridges agricultural valuation expertise, business requirements, data science, and credit decisioning to ensure valuation approaches are practical, credible, and aligned to business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
• Provide expert guidance on agricultural valuation methodologies and asset pricing principles.
• Advise on the development and refinement of machine learning valuation models.
• Support identification of valuation drivers, assumptions, and business rules.
• Review and interpret model outputs and provide recommendations.
• Conduct research on valuation practices, market trends, and benchmark data.
• Facilitate knowledge transfer sessions and stakeholder workshops.
• Translate technical modelling concepts into business language.
• Engage with Product, Credit Risk, Agriculture Banking, Data Science, Technology, and Project teams.
• Produce executive presentations, research papers, and recommendation reports
• Support governance, model review, and decision-making forums.
Required Skills and Experience
• Demonstrated experience in agricultural valuation, agribusiness economics, agricultural finance, or related disciplines.
• Strong understanding of valuation methodologies and collateral valuation principles.
• Experience supporting analytical, statistical, or machine learning models.
• Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with business, technical, and executive stakeholders.
• Experience within banking, agricultural finance, credit risk, or lending environments is advantageous.
Key Deliverables
• Agricultural valuation methodology recommendations.
• Model review, validation, and advisory feedback.
• Data and valuation research reports.
• Stakeholder education and knowledge transfer material.
• Executive briefing papers and presentation packs.
• Valuation framework documentation.
• Inputs into POC recommendations and implementation planning.
Success Measures
• Improved quality and credibility of valuation outputs.
• Increased stakeholder confidence in valuation methodologies.
• Effective translation of model outputs into business insights
• High-quality advisory and knowledge management support.
• Timely delivery of agreed research and documentation
